patches.note: Unmodified upstream one-line device-table addition; not a fake GPU override.

Serializes the per-context sampler and sampler view seqno allocator, which threaded_context uses from two threads, and reserves seqno 0. Duplicate seqnos made the A6xx-A8xx texture state cache return state built for another texture (fd6_texture_state assertion `state->view_rsc_seqno[i] == seqno`). Still unfixed in upstream main as of 2026-10-22.
